text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My name is Orfevre. ...Bow down and revere 
me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am the King who rules the turf. Know 
that all glory and acclaim belong solely 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If you dare block my way, I shall simply 
trample you underfoot. Bear witness—to the 
path of my supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
